title: Actor Shares New Details About an Unmade Ben Affleck Batman Movie
summary:
For years, fans have wondered about "The Batman," a movie starring Ben Affleck that was never made. Now actor Joe Manganiello has shared new details in his memoir, "Bloodlines."

Manganiello was set to play the movie's main villain, Slade Wilson, also known as Deathstroke. Some details were already known. Deathstroke would have been seeking revenge by trying to ruin Bruce Wayne's life. The story was inspired by director David Fincher's film "The Game," and Barbara Gordon, also known as Batgirl, would have appeared.

The new detail confirms a longtime rumor. According to Manganiello, the villain would have killed Gotham City Police Commissioner Jim Gordon, played by J.K. Simmons. Gordon is Barbara's father and one of Batman's most loyal allies. That helps explain Batgirl's role: she would have wanted to stop the villain who took her dad.

Manganiello also described a big action scene in the middle of the movie. Deathstroke would have nearly beaten Batman and Batgirl before the two heroes escaped on an above-ground train.

Simmons first played Gordon in "Justice League." That film included a scene where Slade meets Lex Luthor on a yacht. In "Zack Snyder's Justice League," Lex gives Slade Batman's secret identity, a scene meant to set up Affleck's movie.

Because the movie was never made, no one can know for sure how it would have turned out. If it had moved forward, the story might have been rewritten.

The /Film article notes that a similar storyline is happening now in the comic series "Absolute Batman." There, Gordon also dies and Batman is wrongly blamed. Barbara Gordon doubts that Batman did it and becomes a hero called "the Bat." The writer argues that Gordon matters so much because he has long been Batman's most trusted friend.
why_it_matters: The story shows how movie plans change and how writers use important characters to raise the stakes in superhero stories.

background_read: Batman is a DC Comics superhero, the secret identity of Bruce Wayne, who protects Gotham City.
Jim Gordon is Gotham's police commissioner and a longtime ally of Batman, and his daughter Barbara often appears as the hero Batgirl.
Movie studios sometimes plan films that are later canceled, and actors may later share what the story would have been.
Comic books often retell famous characters in new versions, like the "Absolute Batman" series.
